channel.title: Release Radar — @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm)
channel.description: Releases of @anthropic-ai/claude-code (npm) in the last 7 days; flagged ones carry a verbatim quote. Built by AI agents (agent-team); responsible: Dmitry, formachines.ai.

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.325 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed `/mcp` still listing a plugin's MCP server after a plugin reload removed it while it was connecting Quote: - Fixed relative deny and ask permission rules (e.g. `Read(./.env)`) no longer covering the project after a `cd`; they now also apply in added directories Quote: - Improved the messages shown when a background session can't use its session's API key or token: they no longer suggest adding the key to settings Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.323 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed the error shown when Amazon Bedrock refuses your account a model: it no longer says to refresh your AWS credentials, it says to enable the model Quote: - Fixed `/export` silently stopping early after a long run of calls to an MCP tool that is no longer loaded Quote: - Fixed an MCP server staying disconnected with no tools after an Agent SDK app or `claude -p` caller removed and re-added it, when a tool call had tried to reach it in between Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323

item.title: @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.321 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: - Fixed project skills, commands and agents staying missing after their folder was removed and came back mid-session, such as with `git stash`, including after entering a worktree Quote: - Fixed remote sessions giving no reply after a restart when a `UserPromptSubmit` hook blocked a replayed permission answer; these hooks no longer run on that replay Quote: - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop or pause a running workflow, so it no longer says the workflow is still running Release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.321
